name: Avatar of Khaine

bonuses.name: Molten Form
bonuses.text: The Avatar is immune to the Bleeding, Exhausted, On Fire, and Poisoned Conditions, and cannot Suffocate.

bonuses.name: Khaine Awakened
bonuses.text: Allied ASURYANI who can see the Avatar gain +3 bonus dice on Resolve tests, and can Sprint as part of Charges. The Avatar itself does not gain these bonuses.

bonuses.name: Second Strike
bonuses.text: This Threat reduces the Multi-Atack penalty by 2 DN, as though it had the Dual Wield Talent (Wrath & Glory Rulebook page 133).

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: The Avatar may use Ruin Actions and has 6 personal Ruin.

abilities.name: Doom of Mortals
abilities.text: Enemies who see the Avatar must make a DN 4 Terror test.

abilities.name: Burning Demise
abilities.text: If an attack which destroys the Avatar rolls a Complication, the Avatar explodes as though it were the epicentre of a Blast weapon's attack: 10 +5 ED / AP -2 / Blast (6), Inflict (On Fire).

determination: Divine Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 13d6. The Avatar can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.
note: Printed 'Multi-Atack' and 'Resolve tests' kept. Keyword 'DAEMON MONSTER' printed without a comma, kept as one. The Wailing Doom's shooting profile is written '+3 ED' (23 +3 ED).
